basic_info.description: Welcome to 1983 10th Avenue, a stylish mid-century modern home in Golden Gate Heights with sweeping views of Mt. Sutro, Twin Peaks, the Bay, and the Golden Gate Bridge. Spanning ~1,740 sq ft across two levels, this bright single-family residence features 3 spacious bedrooms and 1.5 baths. The sun-drenched living room is anchored by a fireplace and picture windows, flowing seamlessly into a formal dining area and an updated kitchen with breakfast bar, new counters, and stainless appliances. Newly refinished hardwood floors, skylit staircase landing, and thoughtful updates throughout highlight the home's modern comfort and charm.  Sliding doors extend living spaces to the outdoors, where a multi-tiered garden awaits with an oversized sun deck, stone patio, and faux-grass terrace. Upstairs, serene bedrooms enjoy city and garden outlooks, while the main level bedroom opens directly to the deck. A two-car garage, laundry room, and ample storage complete this inviting home. Perfectly situated near Golden Gate Park, neighborhood trails, and the vibrant dining and shopping of the Inner Sunset and West Portal.
